recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, bright portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and light blue shirt, set against a nearly white, overexposed background. The composition uses a clean, modern sans-serif for the primary name and a fluid, handwritten script for the secondary title, overlapping the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black hat against a blown-out white background
Cool blue shirt tones harmonizing with dark blue typography
Structured sans-serif lettering paired with organic, cursive script
Subject's gaze directed away from the camera to create a candid feel
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a distinct brim curve
Light blue button-down shirt with visible texture
Typography placed in the lower-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right side of the frame, cropped at the waist, occupying approximately 60% of the horizontal space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black cowboy hat serves as the primary visual anchor due to its high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the dark hat, move down the subject's face to the blue shirt, and settle on the typography in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left side, created by the overexposed background, providing a clean area for text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light Blue (Shirt) and Navy Blue (Script Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the hat and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones in the background
Limit colors to white, black, and shades of blue

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, all-caps geometric characters with consistent stroke weight
Secondary text uses a thin, connected script with variable line weight and long ascenders/descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'f' and 'q' have elongated tails that extend below the baseline to create movement

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the negative space and edge of the shirt

composition.position: directly below and slightly overlapping primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, modern geometry and fluid, personal handwriting.
graphicDevices: Text overlap on subject to create depth

preserve: The specific navy blue color for the script
avoid: Heavy bold weights for the script

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look for the primary name.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Mistral or a custom signature font
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, handwritten quality of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and a light blue shirt, looking off-camera with a smile. The background must be completely blown out to pure white. Lighting should be soft and even on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the artist name in a wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif in the lower left. Directly beneath it, place the title in a navy blue, fluid cursive script that slightly overlaps the man's arm.

verificationChecks: Is the hat the darkest element in the image?
Does the script text overlap the subject?
Is the sans-serif text tracked out widely?

adjustableVariables: Shirt color (can be changed to other light pastels)
Script color (can be adjusted to match other accents)
Subject's pose (can be front-facing or profile)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the hat or shirt
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the white and blue areas.
Check that the hat maintains a sharp silhouette.
Verify the color balance is cool-toned.
Confirm the script font feels like natural handwriting.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Black Western Headwear + Geometric Sans/Script Pairing = Modern Country Aesthetic
